description:
At least 110 children have been killed in Israel’s war in Lebanon since the conflict began again this month. CNN’s Isobel Yeung looks at the cost civilians are paying for the IDF’s campaign against Hezbollah, as one Israeli airstrike wiped out nine members of the same family, including five children.

The IDF have said they will look into the incident CNN documented.

2:44 The Hezbollah stronghold of Tyre has taken heavy fire

author: CNN
description:
As the US-Israel war against Iran nears the end of its third week, US President Donald Trump has downplayed prospects of a ceasefire contending the US has the upper hand and would like a decisive end to the war. Thousands more US Marines and sailors are heading towards the Middle East. Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, rose early Friday to more than $110 a barrel.

Here's a roundup of retired US generals analyzing the third week of the Iran war.

0:00 Maj Gen 'Spider' Marks on the significance and obstacles of Kharg Island
4:52 Brig Gen Anderson on introducing new inventory to reopen the strait
9:37 Gen Weatherington on bunker buster effectiveness, need for boots on the ground
13:37 Gen Kimmitt on speed boat threat and signals from Iranian leadership
16:34 Gen Schwartz on the marine amphibious ready group
21:46 Gen Seidule on the importance of respecting our allies and Israel's role/limits

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#IranWar #Military #News
title: Retired generals break down Iran war strategy after week 3
